name: RemoraHQ - Integrations
description: RemoraHQ external-service integrations bridge. Currently exposes Jira REST proxy actions (test connection + create issue). The API token is read from process.env on the Mesh server (.env-friendly) and never travels through the browser. PSO and SIEM connectors live elsewhere — PSO is browser-only (open URL + copy/paste), SIEM is planned.
